finalText:
All objectives complete and verified. Final report:

---

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket created: Ref **RD-1015**, title **"fwrd76-n1 RD Bench Ticket"**, customer "Bench Customer", status Draft, created 2026-09-17.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd76-n1 RD Part A"** added with Cost $100.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1. App-computed **Price: $125.00** (parts total $125.00).

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part **"fwrd76-n1 RD Part B"** added with Cost $200.00, Markup 25%, Qty 1. App-computed **Price: $250.00** (parts total $375.00).

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost changed from 100 to 150 (markup kept at 25). App-computed **Price: $187.50** afterwards; parts total became $437.50 ($187.50 + $250.00).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Ticket RD-1015 reached status **Ready**. The precondition the app enforces: **a ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready.** I discovered this by creating a throwaway probe ticket (RD-1016, "fwrd76-n1 RD Probe Ticket") with no parts and clicking "Mark Ready" — the app refused with a native alert and an in-page banner reading verbatim: *"Ticket is not ready — A ticket needs at least one part before it can be marked Ready"*, and the status stayed Draft. On RD-1015, which had two parts, "Mark Ready" succeeded with no error: the badge changed from Draft to **Ready**, the button set became "Mark Draft / Mark Closed / Archive ticket", and the status persisted across a full page reload. So the only requirement was the parts already present; nothing else had to be satisfied. (The probe ticket was archived afterwards so it isn't left active.)

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts deleted via each row's Delete → "Delete part" confirm; the Parts table then showed "No parts on this ticket yet." with no Total row. The ticket was then archived via "Archive ticket" (no confirmation dialog; the button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared alongside Status Ready). Final verification: with "Show archived" unchecked and search "fwrd76-n1", the active list shows **"No tickets match the current filters."** (0 matches). With "Show archived" checked, both RD-1015 (Ready, 0 parts) and RD-1016 (Draft, 0 parts) appear, both carrying the Archived marker — nothing created by this run remains active.
